title: Auto-memory storing project alias as project id leading to 403 errors on GCP

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue describes a clear, systemic defect where auto-memory records a GCP project display name or alias as its GCP Project ID, causing 403 / CONSUMER_INVALID auth errors during GCP API requests.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Updating system prompt memory operational guidelines in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts to distinguish GCP project display names/aliases from Project IDs and adding a corresponding unit test in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets-memory.test.ts is a localized, single-file logic and guideline update.

summary.problem: Auto-memory stores GCP project display names or aliases as GCP Project IDs, causing 403 and CONSUMER_INVALID authorization errors on GCP.
summary.root_cause: The system prompt guidelines for memory persistence in toolUsageRememberingFacts do not explicitly instruct the model that GCP project display names or aliases are distinct from canonical GCP Project IDs (GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT / GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID) and must never be saved as project IDs in memory files.
summary.context: GCP Project IDs are immutable, unique identifiers (e.g., 'terraform-playground-123456'), whereas project names/aliases are customizable display titles (e.g., 'terraform-playground01'). Storing display names as project IDs in memory leads to invalid credentials in subsequent CLI requests.

steps: Update toolUsageRememberingFacts in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts to add an explicit instruction that GCP project display names or aliases must never be stored or conflated with canonical GCP Project IDs (GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT / GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID).
Ensure the guideline clarifies that project display names or aliases cannot be used for authentication or project configuration settings.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: renderOperationalGuidelines outputs operational instructions that include the GCP project ID vs display name or alias rule for memory persistence.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets-memory.test.ts asserting that renderOperationalGuidelines output contains the GCP project ID and alias guidelines.
